name: ordinal_word
description: Write the English ordinal word for an integer 1-10 (3 -> third). Control: same format but answer is the cardinal word (3 -> three).
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
O=['first','second','third','fourth','fifth','sixth','seventh','eighth','ninth','tenth']
C=['one','two','three','four','five','six','seven','eight','nine','ten']
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    sh=random.sample(range(10),3); q=random.choice([x for x in range(10) if x not in sh])
    p=''.join(f"Position {a+1} in line: the {O[a]}\n" for a in sh)+f"Position {q+1} in line: the"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+O[q]})
    p2=''.join(f"Count {a+1} in words: the {C[a]}\n" for a in sh)+f"Count {q+1} in words: the"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":" "+C[q]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
